name: tjs
description: The world's fastest and most accurate JSON Schema validator, with magical typescript inference
author: Sam Beran <sberan@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:runtime
scripts.bench:all: npm run bench:ajv && npm run bench:zod && npm run bench:joi && npm run bench:jsonschema && npm run bench:is-my-json-valid && npm run bench:z-schema && npm run bench:djv && npm run bench:jsen && npm run bench:schemasafe && npm run bench:summary
scripts.bench:summary: tsx benchmarks/generate-summary.ts && tsx benchmarks/update-readme.ts && tsx benchmarks/update-svg.ts
scripts.bench:ajv: tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts tjs --json benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts ajv --json benchmarks/results/ajv-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-compare.ts benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json benchmarks/results/ajv-isolated.json --json benchmarks/results/ajv.json && tsx benchmarks/json-to-markdown.ts benchmarks/results/ajv.json > benchmarks/results/BENCHMARK_AJV.md
scripts.docs:build: esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --outfile=docs/tjs.bundle.js && mkdir -p docs/dist && cp dist/types.d.ts dist/infer.d.ts docs/dist/
scripts.bench:zod: tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts tjs --json benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts zod --json benchmarks/results/zod-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-compare.ts benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json benchmarks/results/zod-isolated.json --json benchmarks/results/zod.json && tsx benchmarks/json-to-markdown.ts benchmarks/results/zod.json > benchmarks/results/BENCHMARK_ZOD.md
scripts.bench:joi: tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts tjs --json benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts joi --json benchmarks/results/joi-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-compare.ts benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json benchmarks/results/joi-isolated.json --json benchmarks/results/joi.json && tsx benchmarks/json-to-markdown.ts benchmarks/results/joi.json > benchmarks/results/BENCHMARK_JOI.md
scripts.bench:jsonschema: tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts tjs --json benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts jsonschema --json benchmarks/results/jsonschema-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-compare.ts benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json benchmarks/results/jsonschema-isolated.json --json benchmarks/results/jsonschema.json && tsx benchmarks/json-to-markdown.ts benchmarks/results/jsonschema.json > benchmarks/results/BENCHMARK_JSONSCHEMA.md
scripts.bench:is-my-json-valid: tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts tjs --json benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-isolated.ts is-my-json-valid --json benchmarks/results/is-my-json-valid-isolated.json && tsx benchmarks/bench-compare.ts benchmarks/results/tjs-isolated.json benchmarks/results/is-my-json-valid-isolated.json --json benchmarks/results/is-my-json-valid.json && tsx benchmarks/json-to-markdown.ts benchmarks/results/is-my-json-valid.json > benchmarks/results/BENCHMARK_IS_MY_JSON_VALID.md
